title: Isolation Cells
constraints: Signals leaving a power-gated domain (`pd_*`) float when that domain is off. With `iso_en = 1`, each output is clamped to its **inactive** value: `ao_data = 0`, `ao_valid = 0`, and the active-low `ao_req_n = 1`.
With `iso_en = 0`, all signals pass straight through.
hints: Clamp-0 cell: `out = in & ~iso_en`. Clamp-1 cell: `out = in | iso_en`.
The clamp value must be the **inactive** level of each signal, or the always-on logic will see a spurious request while the domain is off.
In a UPF flow these cells are inserted by the tools. Here you write them by hand.
